chronology: The original S0 document is retrospective: its claimed pre-implementation chronology is not independently auditable from git. This replacement is the operative protocol for the repair rerun.

selection_rules.primary_set: all eight manifest records, exactly as listed
selection_rules.include: record complete=true; checkpoint and record hashes match this manifest; verified rebuilt train and validation fingerprints match the record; train and validation opcode sets are equal; absolute byte codec; policy reconstructed from train+validation
selection_rules.exclude: planner records, missing or hash-drifted artifacts, partial records, corpus drift, policy drift, non-byte codecs, or any checkpoint not listed above
selection_rules.aggregation: never pool families or model seeds in a primary test; report each family/model seed; combine only through the frozen family-level Holm table

seed_roles.data_seed: read from and verified against each checkpoint record

sampler.variates: one pre-generated uniform per row and step, shared across raw, vm_safe and canonical cells
sampler.raw_termination: legacy dm.isa.codec.HaltMonitor, unchanged; grammar state is observation only
sampler.geometry: same reference seed and cloud-point count as the recorded sampler configuration; any unavailable_empty draw makes the report incomplete

support_accounting.q: probability outside the level support, from temperature-1 logits before forbid and top_k
support_accounting.renormalisation: -log2(legal mass), with mean, sample standard deviation and p50/p90/p95/p99/max
support_accounting.attribution: persist exclusive first-exclusion causes; dynamic bits are exact stagewise renormalisation costs, not proportional allocation
support_accounting.reconciliation: exclusive mass sums to union mass; stage costs telescope to union renormalisation cost

inference.unit: paired draw within checkpoint; model seeds remain an outer level
inference.interval: two-sided Student-t 95% interval on the five paired draw deltas
inference.p_value: two-sided paired Student-t test on the five deltas with df=4; exact sign-flip p-value is retained as a robustness diagnostic
inference.multiplicity: Holm step-down alpha=0.05 across the four named checkpoint families, separately for each model seed; no pooling across seeds
inference.secondary: fault, cap, length and geometry columns are diagnostics and are not silently promoted to co-primary tests

gate.baseline_gap: raw mean valid_halt_rate <= 0.95 in at least one primary family/model-seed report
gate.dynamic_mass: canonical teacher-forced dynamic_bits_per_drawing >= 0.01 in at least one primary report, or canonical-vm_safe dynamic residual >= 0.005
gate.decoder_effect: canonical-minus-raw valid_halt paired mean >= 0.05, exact/Holm decision rejects zero, and no primary geometry/length floor fails

floors.geometry_completion: all requested geometry draws complete; unavailable_empty is incomplete

gate.c3_decision: C3 is positive only if the cluster-bootstrap 95% interval for D_minus_control excludes zero, point estimate is >= 0.02 bits/target-byte, both existing model seeds have the same sign, and the held-out/support/frequency controls do not reverse the compatibility ordering
gate.pass: baseline_gap AND (dynamic_mass OR decoder_effect) AND c3_positive AND all required artifacts complete
gate.authorization: only a mechanically evaluated pass authorizes S4; otherwise S4 remains closed

context_c3.venue: absolute-byte flat synthetic repeats, exact copy-3 natural step twins
context_c3.primary_cases: fixed case manifest created before model loading; same length and opcode-kind skeleton; canonical and VM acceptance asserted
context_c3.control: same-length/signature unrelated donor and non-copy control, scored with the same four-way contrast
context_c3.bootstrap: scene/case cluster bootstrap, deterministic seed 20260815, 2000 replicates; no token-level independence assumption
